name: Josiah P. Hanna
title: Assistant Professor; Prediction and Action Lab Director
fitReason: Strong algorithmic robot-learning fit: physical dynamics embedded in neural policy structure, data-efficient model learning and uncertain-state inference, validated on legged robots.

physicalEvidence.summary: March 2026 ABD-Net Sec. V-B deploys learned policies on real Unitree G1 and Go2, with onboard Jetson Orin NX inference at 50 Hz and PD control at 200 Hz; G1 walking/dancing and Go2 locomotion across several terrains. EMBRL, listed as ICRA 2026, Sec. VII-C uses a real NAOv6 to navigate around an obstacle using camera-observed field landmarks. Current PAL PhD students Sangwoo Shin and William Cong lead these respective papers. This establishes current-group involvement, without asserting exclusive ownership or laboratory location of every platform.

shortVisit.summary: Homepage recruitment text addresses CS PhD admission and research by already-enrolled UW–Madison undergraduates. Current MS advisees are listed, but no external short-visit invitation or summer 2027 opening was found. The no-individual-email-replies statement appears in the prospective PhD paragraph, not as a universal visitor ban.
